fieldValues.chose: Closed the cycle 2026-10-25 11:30 to 2026-10-26 11:30 UTC. Two group PRs merged by the owner, both with approving quorum comments (builder editor-builder, reviewer editor-reviewer): srs-web#620 (essay names its domain and maps it; mandate remedy 5f200696 affirmed as dddaa2e3) and srs-web#621 (essay read-only until the writer gives a name; mandate remedy 9ce3dedc affirmed). Both were owner-merge, so no delegated budget used. Open: srs-rust#1472 (session AttentionState), rejected by the reviewer on three red checks (Schema Drift x2, CI) at 0fd4d69, the Builder replied but has pushed nothing since 2026-10-25 08:53; srs-web#607 and srs-web#628 carry gate:owner-merge. No decision awaited assent, so no group session was held. No new escalation. Pause state: ok.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation. Nothing outside the role's boundary was stopped on: the red checks on srs-rust#1472 are the Builder's to fix (the drift is the mirror lagging srs master, which the schema-sync workflow resolves). The earlier inform item (who files the essay package change in muDemocracy.org after ruling 5d5feb79) is still unclaimed and is repeated in the report.
